messages:
maya: kicked off canary deploy for v4.3 to us-west about 6m ago. initial healthchecks looked ok but smokebot flagged a few transient 502s on the embed endpoint.

deploy-bot: Deploy v4.3 -> canaries deployed (6/6). tag: v4.3.0-rc2.

smokebot: synthetic probe: /v1/embed observed 3 failures out of 8 samples; majority from usw-can-04. p95 elevated (~2x).

zack: checking proxy and host metrics. usw-can-04 shows kv_prefill_backlog spike and a handful of upstream read_timeouts.

maya: running a focused probe against usw-can-04 now, posting curl:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://usw-can-04.api.redwood/v1/embed -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"input":"probe"}' -w "\n%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
```

maya: results x4 -> 200 0.18, 502 0.34, 200 0.17, 200 0.16 (intermittent as smokebot showed).

ops: host metric snapshot -> kv_prefill_workers=1 backlog=10 prefill_errors=0.

zack: hypothesis: new host startup prefill lagged, creating head-of-line misses for early requests. plan: trigger targeted prefill for embed prefixes and bump concurrency temporarily.

maya: executing targeted prefill now. output: "queued 5 prefixes -> concurrency=3 -> processed 5 -> done in 19s".

smokebot: rerun synthetic -> /v1/embed 8/8 success from usw-can-04. p50/p95 back to baseline.

zack: recommendation: proceed with cautious rollforward — schedule remainder of us-west in 20m, pin v4.3 on canaries for 12h, and enable temporary alert for embed p99 and kv_prefill_backlog>6. add ops playbook entry: trigger prefill + hold rollout if canary errors recur.

maya: +1. I'll update internal release notes: "v4.3.0-rc2 - gradual rollout. Observed transient kv prefill backlog on usw-can-04 causing brief 502s to /v1/embed; mitigation: targeted prefill executed and verification passed. Rollout resumed with 20m observation window and 12h canary pin."

ops: created alert rule and pinned release in deploy dashboard. also filed follow-up ticket INFRA-7123 "startup prefill visibility + adjustable concurrency".

zack: oncall checklist for observation window: 1) monitor embed p99 and error rate 2) confirm kv_prefill_backlog drains on new hosts 3) if failure rate >5% over 5m, abort rollout and pin.

maya: i'll be watching for the next 90m. ping if alerts fire.

smokebot: reaction :white_check_mark:.

maya: thanks team. will publish a short internal blurb and hold public changelog until observation passes. closing thread after 12h if stable.
